criteria.name: canonical adaptive collaboration system
criteria.statement: YIYUAN Accord exposes one Agent-neutral and mechanism-neutral human-Agent collaboration system with a small portable reliability kernel, adaptive outcome-delivery surfaces, a single canonical identity, a bounded current claim and an explicit broader human-AI mission.
criteria.passRule: A clean checkout validates the current declared semantic authority set, the revisable reshaping guidance, CONTEXT.md and one generic data-driven verifier; goal, requirement, capability, authority, evidence and cost remain aligned with context, state, effect, continuity, topology and lifecycle. Schema v3 currently bootstraps constitution, program and acceptance, but that topology and its release checkpoints are reviewable and may change only through an explicit schema, verifier and provenance-preserving migration rather than by silent file accretion or deletion. Durable semantic records stay separate from ephemeral host snapshots and derived indexes. The Git index is available and contains only merged stage-zero regular release files; their paths and strictly decoded non-Python whole text are free of exact NFKC/casefold lexical superseded identity tokens, and declared .py, .pyi and .pyw identifiers, literal values and bounded static concatenations are free of those tokens under the current release's declared Python 3.10-compatible AST grammar for stable semantics; both that grammar baseline and the currently exercised CPython 3.10-3.14 matrix are reviewable compatibility decisions rather than a permanent host whitelist or product identity. Indeterminate surfaces block conformance and hidden checkout flags block clean-candidate readiness. Digest-bound Markdown research inputs under research/reviews and exact program-declared SHA-256-bound PNG distribution assets are bounded exceptions; no compatibility alias is declared, and absence from ignored or untracked files, Python comments, runtime-built or external dynamic content is not claimed.

criteria.name: adaptive host projections and admission
criteria.statement: YIYUAN Accord uses Agent-neutral capability and resource semantics with replaceable discovery, execution and stewardship adapters. Capabilities may originate in models, hosts, clients, extensions, configuration, composition or bounded authorship. Concrete Agents are first evidence surfaces, never the product boundary or capability ceiling; future surfaces enter through the same lifecycle contract.
criteria.passRule: Admission separates static readiness, availability, installation, enablement, applicability, activation, behavior and value. It normalizes stable capability meaning apart from effective instances bound to the observed Agent, host, carrier, model route, tools, configuration, permissions, context and time; no instance inherits fitness from a product, model, marketplace or installation label. Admit a Skill, plugin, App, MCP, Hook, configuration, runtime, cloud carrier, resource primitive or composed route only when supported, authorized, beneficial and bounded for interference, update, rollback and retirement. Native controls or traces do not prove whole-loop resource governance; sufficient native governance is a no-op. Codex Cloud seeks an effective projection through replaceable mechanisms, not mandatory plugin installation. Host differences stay explicit, model and version remain variables, and no unobserved surface inherits behavior or portability claims.
